topic.title: Personal Workspace
topic.shortdesc: The personal workspace is a private copy of the project where Contributors prepare their changes before proposing them.

body.p: When you open a project, your work happens in a personal workspace. This workspace is yours alone. The files you edit there are not visible to the other project members and do not affect the project content.
You edit files in the browser-based editor, the same way an author does. You can modify several files and continue working on them across sessions until your proposal is ready.

section.title: What You Do in the Personal Workspace

ul.li: Open and edit the project files.
Track your local changes in the Changes view.
Prepare updates across several files as one set of work.
Create a review task from your changes when you are ready to propose them.

section.title: How It Differs From an Author's Workspace
section.p: A Contributor's Changes view does not include the Commit action (changes never go directly into the project). Use the New Review Task action to send them to the project team.
Workspace views used to manage the project are also not shown. See What Is Not Available.
